title: AntennaPod Episode Playback Seconds Leaderboard
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=antennapod:episode playback_seconds=*
| stats sum(playback_seconds) as total_value, avg(playback_seconds) as avg_value by podcast_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks podcast values by total and average playback seconds across AntennaPod episode events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `playback_seconds` values for each AntennaPod episode event and review total and average playback seconds by podcast.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total playback seconds.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which podcast shows the biggest playback seconds numbers in your AntennaPod episode data.
